mapper.select: SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM bill.bill b ORDER BY b.bill_id
SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.bill_id
mapper.sql: p.prj_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id, c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,p.stlm_mthd_cd AS settlement,p.use_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT p.prj_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('MO','DP') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= (#{month} || '-01')::date + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day' AND a.end_dt >= (#{month} || '-01')::date) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=p.prj_id AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'))
SELECT m.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls m WHERE m.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT max(m.cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls m WHERE m.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
SELECT s.num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std s WHERE s.oprt_std_id='VAT_RATE' AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY s.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.bill_stg_id,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.prj_id=#{projectId} AND s.bill_stg_id=#{stageId}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, d.dev_nm AS display_name,d.mng_no AS management_number,a.asgn_se_cd AS kind,a.bgn_dt,m.mm_qty, u.bill_untprc_amt AS price,t.work_day_qty,t.rglr_tm_qty,t.ovtm_tm_qty,t.mth_work_day_qty,t.atnd_id FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= greatest(#{first},a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{last} AND a.end_dt >= #{first} ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT l.asgn_id,a.dev_id,l.cntrct_dev_id,d.dev_nm AS display_name,l.work_ym,l.mm_qty, m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,l.untprc_amt,l.work_day_qty,l.work_tm_qty,l.ovtm_tm_qty, l.ovtm_amt,l.bill_amt,l.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl l LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=l.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=l.cntrct_dev_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=l.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=l.work_ym WHERE l.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT concat(h.clmn_nm,': ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id}::text) OR (CASE WHEN h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' THEN coalesce(h.bfr_val,h.aft_val)::jsonb ->> 'bill_id' END = #{id}::text) ORDER BY h.chg_at,h.data_chg_hist_id
SELECT h.send_at AS sent_at FROM bill.dun_hist h WHERE h.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.send_at,h.dun_hist_id

SELECT s.bsn_part_nm AS sales_part,s.hq_yn FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bsn_part_id FROM prj.prj_part_hist h WHERE h.prj_id=p.prj_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part s ON s.bsn_part_id=coalesce(h.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_id) WHERE p.prj_id=#{projectId}
SELECT r.rcpt_dt,sum(r.rcpt_amt)::bigint AS rcpt_amt FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE extract(year FROM r.rcpt_dt)=#{year} GROUP BY r.rcpt_dt ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended( 'B-' || to_char((#{month} || '-01')::date,'YYMM') || '-',0))::text

SELECT 'B-' || to_char((#{month} || '-01')::date,'YYMM') || '-' || CASE WHEN n.sequence < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || n.sequence::text FROM ( SELECT coalesce(max(substring(b.bill_no FROM 8)::bigint),0)+1 AS sequence FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_no LIKE 'B-' || to_char((#{month} || '-01')::date,'YYMM') || '-%' AND substring(b.bill_no FROM 8) ~ '^[0-9]+$' ) n

INSERT INTO bill.bill(bill_no,prj_id,atrb_ym,bill_dt,sply_amt,vat_amt,bill_stts_cd,amnd_yn, orgnl_bill_id,rcpt_plan_dt,txinv_no,txinv_dt,rmrk_desc,created_by) SELECT #{number},b.prj_id,b.atrb_ym,#{input.bill_dt},#{input.sply_amt},#{input.vat_amt},'DRAFT','Y', b.bill_id,#{input.rcpt_plan_dt},#{input.txinv_no},#{input.txinv_dt},#{input.reason},#{actor} FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{rootId} RETURNING bill_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill.bill_dtl(bill_id,work_ym,bill_amt,rmrk_desc) SELECT b.bill_id,coalesce(b.atrb_ym,to_char(coalesce(b.bill_dt,b.created_at::date),'YYYY-MM')), b.sply_amt,left(b.rmrk_desc,200) FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} AND b.bill_stts_cd='DRAFT'
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill b SET bill_stts_cd=#{after},updated_by=#{actor}, rmrk_desc=coalesce(#{reason},b.rmrk_desc) ,cnfrm_user_id=#{actor},cnfrm_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} AND b.bill_stts_cd=#{before}
